subject: general
question: Who among the following is NOT a Nobel prize winner?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** has never won the Nobel prize.
 
• Mohandas Gandhi has become the strongest symbol of non-violence in the** 20th century**.
 
• It is widely held in retrospect that the Indian national leader should have been the very man to be selected for the** Nobel Peace Prize**.
 
• He was nominated several times, but was **never** awarded the prize.
 
• **Gandhiji** was nominated in 1937, 1938, 1939, 1947, and, the last time in 1948, a few days before his assassination.
 
• The **Nobel Committee** had even expressed regret over not giving him the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Poet **Rabindranath Tagore **won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1913 for his collection Gitanjali published in London in 1912.
